text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant... It's... over?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
My mind was completely blank the
whole time,
but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I finished the race. I did, didn't I? Then
everyone
must've seen my running and
felt how badly I
wanted to—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That's all for the races this afternoon,
huh?
Kitasan Black sure gave it the ol'
college try.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Now, then! Here's were things
actually get
interesting. The next race
has...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... This hurts so much! It feels like
someone
just threw cold water in my
face... I didn't realize
how insignificant I
was in other people's eyes...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though her performance was more
than
respectable, Kitasan Black looks
miserable
coming back from the race.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was on a different level! I knew
the
Twinkle Series was going to be hard
going in, but
I'm nowhere near qualified
to run in it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's pace was so fast, and I felt
terrified on
the track! It was all I could
do to just run like mad!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It felt like I'd be pushed right into last
place if I
let my guard down for even a
second...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So this is what my dad and his students meant by the uncertainty of only getting one shot...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! They'd be like, "You only get one
shot on
stage, and there's no telling
what will happen. But
that uncertainty is
what makes things interesting."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I know singing on stage and racing on a
track are
two different things, but I bet
this is what they
were talking about.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I realized something else, too. It's not
enough for
me to simply run as hard as I
possibly can!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I mean, not a single person was moved
or thrilled
by my running today...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Anyone could've run like I did. There's
no way I
can make anyone happy with
something so
mediocre! It didn't even
matter to anyone that I
was out there...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black grits her teeth in
frustration as she
realizes just how far
she is from her goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is a universal realization that
dawns on
everyone, and it is certainly
not a bad thing to
understand.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: ここから積み上げていこう！

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah, you're right! I already
knew I had a
long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's just that it'll take me more than a
single leap
to reach my goal. But that's
racing for you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! What I lack is strength! Without
it,
nobody'll even spare me a glance, let
alone crack
a smile.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've got to get way stronger by the time
the
Classic Triple Crown rolls around
next year.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The basics! Yeah, a good foundation is a
must!
I've seen tons of Umas work their
tails off after
debuting and go on to do
great things.
choice_data_list: よし、ならしばらくはじっくり下積みだ
なら、しばらくはじっくり下積みだね

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Now it's my turn! As they say, a journey
of a
thousand miles begins with a single
step!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black tends to rush headlong
into things
and isn't very graceful, so
taking things slow is
definitely the right
call.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to help raise her skills and
strength
slowly while entering her in
races that best suit
her strengths.
